# Read-back

Sheet-Pan Chicken with Potatoes and Broccoli is a Tuesday dinner for four people, made by one cook using one oven, two sheet pans, and one burner. The recipe has no specified deadline; the cook finishes as soon as the work allows. The potatoes roast longest (30 minutes total: 15 minutes alone, then 15 more with chicken and broccoli), the chicken and broccoli roast together for the final 15 minutes, and while the pans roast, the cook makes a pan sauce on the burner and prepares a salad. The salad is dressed only after the chicken has rested for five minutes, and everything comes together for plating. Key sequencing: the oven preheats (15 min), potatoes prep and roast alone (8 + 15 min), chicken preps and roasts with potatoes (10 min prep, 20 min roasting), then broccoli is added for a final 15 minutes while the sauce reduces and the salad is made. The chicken must rest for 8 minutes before slicing, and the salad dressing waits until 5 minutes into that rest.
